scenes.headline: The Deep Sea
scenes.subtext: A short demo of the tube2dscript pipeline
scenes.narration: Two thirds of our planet is ocean, and almost all of it is completely dark.

scenes.headline: Four Thousand Meters Down
scenes.narration: At four thousand meters, the pressure would crush a steel submarine like a tin can.

scenes.headline: Yet Life Finds A Way
bullets: Anglerfish that make their own light
Giant squid the size of a bus
Bacteria that feed on bare rock
scenes.narration: Yet life survives here. Anglerfish that make their own light, giant squid the size of a bus, and bacteria that feed on bare rock.

scenes.headline: We Have Mapped 26%
scenes.subtext: The rest is a blank page
scenes.narration: We have mapped only twenty six percent of the sea floor in detail. The rest is still a blank page.
